card.name: Its/their after 'each has' or 'not without'
card.fires_on: The possessive its or their right after 'Each X has' or 'was not without', where the next words name something particular to that item (own risks, dangers, moments).

modes.label: Each X has its
modes.description: Possessive after 'each [item] has', leading to 'own' features, risks or instructions.
modes.example: Each of these medicines has<< its>> own instructions for use.

modes.label: Not without its
modes.description: Possessive after 'not without', leading to a noun like dangers or moments.
modes.example: However, yeontan was not without<< its>> dangers.

card.writes: Weakly suggests a noun or adjective that names a particular trait, but the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the word 'its' or 'their' when a text says each thing has its own features, or was not without its drawbacks.
evidence: However, yeontan was not without<< its>> dangers.
Each method of contraception has<< its>> specific benefits and risks.
each drug has<< its>> own specific risk profile.
